info.name: Mock EU Registry API
info.description: Manual smoke collection for the mock EU registry API. The flow creates a fresh repo DPP for demonstration, registers metadata, inspects registry lookup responses, and deletes the repo DPP. Registration itself does not contact the repository. Registry metadata has no delete endpoint, so use fresh IDs per run.

item.name: Create repo DPP for registration flow

item.name: Register DPP in mock EU registry

request.description: Stores registration metadata. The dppApiEndpoint is recorded as a URI and is not contacted.

item.name: Read mock registry record by registry id

exec: pm.test('registry id matches runtime value', function () { pm.expect(json.payload.registryIdentifier).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('registryId')); });
pm.test('dpp id matches runtime value', function () { pm.expect(json.payload.dppIdentifier).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('dppId')); });

item.name: Read mock registry record by dpp id

exec: pm.test('registry record points at runtime dpp id', function () { pm.expect(json.payload.dppIdentifier).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('dppId')); });
pm.test('registry record points at runtime product id', function () { pm.expect(json.payload.productIdentifier).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('productId')); });
pm.test('response body is empty', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql(''); });

request.description: Deletes the repo DPP created by this collection. The current mock registry API has no delete endpoint for metadata records, so registry-side isolation comes from fresh IDs per run.
